answer_1.quote: EMG-RAG can generate answers to users' questions when they interact with the smartphone AI assistants. For autofill forms, the goal is to extract personal information from users' EMGs to automatically fill out various online forms... For user services, we focus on two specific domains. a) reminder service: It involves reminding users of recent events and times... b) travel service: We assist users with navigation by providing the address of a destination...
datasets: real-world business dataset from an AI assistant product
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for questions, entities for autofill forms, and event/time/address information for user services

answer_2.quote: For question answering, we assess the quality of generated answers with the ground truth, and reporting ROUGE (R-1/2/L) and BLEU scores. For autofill forms and user services, we generate key entities and report Exact Match (EM) accuracy.

answer_3.quote: For LLM evaluation, we employ a method where GPT-4 self-verifies whether it can generate answers (or entities) that are consistent with those obtained during the data collection...

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly selected 10% of the user data and asked five participants to annotate the answers (for QA) and entities (for AF and US) based on the collected questions and memories.
answer_4.guideline: Participants annotated the correctness of generated answers and entities by comparing them to ground truth.
